_about: Terms. The 2025/2026 terms are from the Supabase project my connector could reach (tenderexam). 2026/2027 Term 1 is what run_promotion() creates and makes current (0014_promotion_terms_rollover.sql: next academic year, term 1); the seed supabase/seed/003 and the portal directory both state that the September 2026 promotion has already been run. The roster now comes from roster_2026_2027.json, not from that project (which is still pre-promotion). To refresh: export terms from production, edit this file, run scripts/generate_teacher_data.py.
